title: Classical structural priors improve neural molecular representations in molecule language models
abstract: arXiv:2611.21276v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Classical molecular similarity is central to chemical information systems, yet molecule-language models trained on paired structure-text data do not necessarily organize molecular embeddings according to graded structural relationships. Here we introduce Structure-Aware Guided Alignment (SAGA), a training-only regularizer that uses Centered Kernel Alignment to align neural molecular representations with fingerprint-based Tanimoto similarity, without adding parameters or requiring fingerprints at inference. In MolCA and Atomas, SAGA improves molecule-text retrieval, shifts non-exact retrieval toward closer structural analogues, and increases average scaffold-split property-prediction performance, while molecular description and text-to-molecule generation are improved or preserved in single-run ablations. These results show that established chemoinformatics priors can make molecule-language representations more chemically faithful while

translated_title: 经典结构先验提升分子语言模型中的神经分子表示
translated_abstract: 经典分子相似性是化学信息系统的核心，然而在结构-文本配对数据上训练的分子语言模型并不一定按照梯度化的结构关系来组织分子嵌入。在此，我们提出了结构感知引导对齐，这是一种仅在训练阶段使用的正则化方法，它利用中心核对齐将神经分子表示与基于分子指纹的Tanimoto相似性对齐，既不增加参数，也无需在推理时使用分子指纹。在MolCA和Atomas模型中，SAGA提升了分子-文本检索性能，使非精确检索的结果更偏向结构更接近的类似物，并提高了基于骨架划分的性质预测的平均性能，同时分子描述生成和文本到分子的生成在单次运行的消融实验中得到改善或保持不变。这些结果表明，成熟的化学信息学先验可以使分子语言表示在化学上更加忠实……
tldr: 提出SAGA训练正则化方法，利用中心核对齐将神经分子表示与指纹Tanimoto相似性对齐，在不增加推理开销的情况下提升分子语言模型的分子-文本检索和性质预测性能，使表示更符合经典化学结构关系。
en_tdlr: SAGA, a training-only regularizer aligning neural molecular representations with fingerprint-based Tanimoto similarity via Centered Kernel Alignment, improves molecule-text retrieval and scaffold-split property prediction in molecule language models without adding parameters or inference-time overhead.
